ambiguities.description: Is ProjectName uniquely identifying? The transcript states each project 'has exactly one project name', establishing that the relationship is 1:1 from Project to ProjectName. However, it is unclear whether the same project name can be assigned to multiple projects (i.e., whether ProjectName is itself unique across all projects). If project names must be globally unique, an additional constraint should apply.
